title: RHEM - Runtime Hard-Example Mining for Agent Systems
description: RHEM is a runtime hard-example mining reference implementation for Agent systems. Version 0.5.0 expands the Agent-level hard-example mining whitepaper, clarifies the boundary between runtime memory updates and model retraining, and documents the four hard-example categories, evolution loop, limitations, and verifiable first-release claims. This is a documentation-focused release and does not claim production performance, statistical optimality, or proven generalization gains.
notes: RHEM v0.5.0 was archived by Zenodo as 10.5281/zenodo.22719697; v0.4.0 remains available as 10.5281/zenodo.22719563; 10.5281/zenodo.22681163 is the concept DOI for the project.
